title: FEARFILES #9: EXTRA PLATE
endSub: Who sits in YOUR extra chair?

cta.text: SUBSCRIBE… OR MISS WHAT HAPPENS NEXT.

lines.text: Never forget the extra plate on Thanksgiving.
Grandma always set one. For the guest, she said.
This year she was gone. So I skipped it.
An old man in a brown coat. I'm here for my plate.
I said: sorry, there's no plate this year.
He smiled. Then I'll take a seat.
When the lights came back, he was gone.
My family sat perfectly still. Smiling.
Then I looked at Grandma's photo from 1952.
lines.say: Then I looked at Grandma's photo from nineteen fifty-two.

lines.text: The man in the brown coat was in it. In my chair.
So never forget the extra plate on Thanksgiving.
